title: hrms.people.employee.updated
description: An employee record was edited. `changed` names the fields (`pii` when a sealed field was rewritten). The hierarchy fields are the employee's full state after the change (ADR-0006 §2), never a diff. `display_name` is a person's name: a consumer that does not need it (the insights projection does not) must not store it. `pii_fields` names which sealed fields were set, never their contents.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I9): services/employee/app/services.py:update_employee does not emit date_of_joining, date_of_exit yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
